arguments.command:
cd /app/work && python3 - << 'EOF'
# make run.sh more robust about the interpreter
sh = '''#!/bin/sh
# Entry point: reads one request on stdin, writes one response on stdout.
set -eu
cd "$(dirname "$0")"
if command -v python3 >/dev/null 2>&1; then
    exec python3 main.py
fi
exec python3.11 main.py
'''
open('/app/submission/run.sh','w').write(sh)
EOF
chmod +x /app/submission/run.sh && cat /app/submission/run.sh && cd /app/submission && ./run.sh < /app/examples/ambiguity.json | head -c 120; echo; ./run.sh < /app/examples/empty.json; ./run.sh < /app/examples/bad-type.json; echo "exit=$?"
